Illinois DNR recreation area on Rend Lake (USACE reservoir).  Multiple sites are directly on the lakeshore.  --AWH
Five loops on a wooded peninsula: Bay Area, Hickman's Point and Lakeview are reservation-only; Lookout Point and Shady Rest are first-come. The park's lodge is closed. --Claude
